current_year=now.year
print('current_year', current_year)

# login file_system
username='ja-solomon@gmail.com'
password=None
for x in apis.supervisor.show_account_passwords():
    if x['account_name']=='file_system':
        password=x['password']
        break
resp=apis.file_system.login(username=username, password=password)
access_token=resp['access_token']

paths=apis.file_system.show_directory(access_token=access_token, directory_path='~/bills', recursive=True)

# electricity files for current year
electricity_files=[p for p in paths if '/bills/electricity/' in p and (p.lower().endswith('.txt') or p.lower().endswith('.pdf')) and re.search(r'/(\d{4})-', p) and int(re.search(r'/(\d{4})-', p).group(1))==current_year]

from collections import defaultdict
by_month=defaultdict(list)
for p in electricity_files:
    m=re.search(r'/(\d{4}-\d{2})\.', p)
    if m:
        by_month[m.group(1)].append(p)

selected=[]
for k, flist in by_month.items():
    txt=[f for f in flist if f.lower().endswith('.txt')]
    pdf=[f for f in flist if f.lower().endswith('.pdf')]
    pick=sorted(txt)[0] if txt else sorted(pdf)[0]
    selected.append(pick)

selected=sorted(selected)
print('selected_files', selected)

# parse total amounts

def parse_total_amount(content):
    # try match 'Total Amount' line
    m=re.search(r'Total Amount\s*=>\s*\$?\s*([0-9]+(?:\.[0-9]{1,2})?)', content, flags=re.IGNORECASE)
    if not m:
        # try 'Total Amount' without =>
        m=re.search(r'Total Amount[^0-9]*([0-9]+(?:\.[0-9]{1,2})?)', content, flags=re.IGNORECASE)
    if not m:
        return None
    return float(m.group(1))

items=[]
for fpath in selected:
    f=apis.file_system.show_file(access_token=access_token, file_path=fpath)
    content=f.get('content','')
    amt=parse_total_amount(content)
    print('file', fpath, 'parsed_amt', amt)
    items.append((fpath, amt))

print('parsed_items', items)

# sum
sum_amt=sum(a for _,a in items if a is not None)
print('sum_amt', sum_amt)

import re
from datetime import datetime
from collections import defaultdict

# Determine current year from environment
current_year = datetime.now().year

# Login file_system
username='ja-solomon@gmail.com'
password=None
for x in apis.supervisor.show_account_passwords():
    if x['account_name']=='file_system':
        password=x['password']
        break

access_token = apis.file_system.login(username=username, password=password)['access_token']

# Find all txt electricity bills for current year
paths = apis.file_system.show_directory(access_token=access_token, directory_path='~/bills', recursive=True)

txt_electricity_paths=[]
for p in paths:
    if '/bills/electricity/' in p and p.lower().endswith('.txt'):
        m=re.search(r'/(\d{4})-', p)
        if m and int(m.group(1))==current_year:
            txt_electricity_paths.append(p)

print('current_year', current_year)
print('txt_electricity_paths', sorted(txt_electricity_paths))

# Parse Total Amount from each file

def parse_total_amount(content):
    m=re.search(r'Total Amount\s*=>\s*\$?\s*([0-9]+(?:\.[0-9]{1,2})?)', content, flags=re.IGNORECASE)
    if not m:
        m=re.search(r'Total Amount[^0-9]*\$?\s*([0-9]+(?:\.[0-9]{1,2})?)', content, flags=re.IGNORECASE)
    return float(m.group(1)) if m else None

items=[]
for p in sorted(txt_electricity_paths):
    content = apis.file_system.show_file(access_token=access_token, file_path=p).get('content','')
    amt=parse_total_amount(content)
    items.append((p, amt))
    print('parsed', p, amt)

sum_amt = sum(amt for _, amt in items if amt is not None)
print('sum_amt', sum_amt)

# complete task
apis.supervisor.complete_task(answer=str(int(round(sum_amt))))
